_about: Controlled vocabulary for BSI QC. Edit here (or promote proposals in the app) to add values. Keys are stored values; labels/help are shown in the app.

qc_class.label: Manure pond
qc_class.help: A plausible open manure lagoon, slurry-storage basin or liquid-manure pond.

qc_class.label: Possible manure
qc_class.help: Wet or liquid feature plausibly related to manure management, but not confidently an open pond.

qc_class.label: Manure-related, not pond
qc_class.help: Manure-related infrastructure or surface that is not an open pond, such as a digester.

qc_class.label: Wet runoff
qc_class.help: Drainage, saturated soil, transient wet ground or runoff without a discrete storage pond.

qc_class.label: Other water
qc_class.help: Non-manure water: stock/irrigation pond, retention pond, reservoir, natural water.

qc_class.label: Other false positive
qc_class.help: Shadow, dark soil, vegetation, roof or another non-pond surface.

qc_class.label: Mixed / merged
qc_class.help: Covers more than one surface class; cannot assign one defensible class. Explain in notes.

qc_class.label: Uncertain
qc_class.help: Insufficient evidence to classify this polygon; note the limitation.

qc_issue.label: None
qc_issue.help: No noteworthy segmentation or clipping issue.

qc_issue.label: Split detection
qc_issue.help: One physical target split across multiple polygons.

qc_issue.label: Merged detection
qc_issue.help: One polygon joins more than one physical target or surface.

qc_issue.label: Missed small feature
qc_issue.help: A relevant small feature next to this polygon seems missed by BSI (includes 'too small to detect' / resolution).

qc_issue.label: Footprint clipping
qc_issue.help: Target is truncated by the supplied operation footprint.

qc_issue.label: Other
qc_issue.help: Another identifiable issue; describe in notes.

qc_result.label: Correct
qc_result.help: Pipeline output is right for this operation.

qc_result.label: Incorrect
qc_result.help: BSI hit a non-manure surface, or missed a visible manure pond.

qc_result.label: Uncertain
qc_result.help: Imagery does not support a defensible interpretation.

qc_site_valid.label: Yes, looks like a cattle operation
No, not a cattle operation (location FP)
